blocks.text: m360 has acquired Concati to expand its services beyond messaging and help businesses strengthen customer engagement and digital security. m360 operates under Brave Connective, a company within Globe-backed 917Ventures. The acquisition brings together messaging, identity verification and fraud prevention capabilities in one platform to support safer digital transactions. The expanded platform will allow businesses to verify customer identities, assess potential risks and engage customers more securely. This comes as online scams remain a concern in the Philippines. A November 2025 study by the GSMA found that 52% of Filipinos had experienced scams at least once, with about two-thirds of those affected […]...
